verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a self-serve 14-day trial and a developer API for batch-adding leads. Neither documents a guided onboarding or data-import flow that gets a founder to a working pipeline with real data quickly and without help. The batch API is a developer building block, not a founder-facing migration capability, and nothing addresses time-to-value or setup without an implementation partner.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner
